title: Permission-matrix editor is read-only for a writable package — `writable` gates on `allowOrgOverride` alone while the server accepts the package-door write
body:
Split out of objectstack-ai/objectstack#7685 item (iii) per file-at-destination — the fix site is this repo. Items (i)/(ii) of that card are verify/qa tooling and stay in `objectstack`. This card is **independent of them**; no `Blocked-by:`.

Filed unassigned and ungraded — routing/grading is the triage seat's call, not the filer's.

## Symptom

On a **stock** boot the permission-matrix editor renders `Read-only (OS_METADATA_WRITABLE not enabled)` with every checkbox disabled — at both the metadata-admin route **and** inside Studio's Access pillar — even for a package that is **writable**.

Meanwhile the server **accepts** the package-door write in that same default environment:

```
PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/<set>?package=<writable pkg>   → 200   (via allowRuntimeCreate)
```

So the client-side type gate locks a surface the server would allow.

## Anchor (read on `origin/main` @ `d8d0d66`, not inferred)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:219`

```ts
const writable = !!resolved.allowOrgOverride && !readOnly;
```

The server returns `allowOrgOverride: false` for type `permission`, so `writable` is false regardless of the package's own writability, and every control downstream of it is disabled (`:735`, `:745`, `:800`, `:1068`, `:1079`, `:1088`, and the `writable` prop threaded at `:846`/`:862`).

**The `|| allowRuntimeCreate` shape already exists in this repo** — it is the permission-matrix editor that is the outlier:

- `metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx:171` — `(e) => e.allowOrgOverride || e.allowRuntimeCreate`
- `metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx:175` — same disjunction for the `writableOnly` filter
- `metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx:93` — `!subEntry.allowOrgOverride && !subEntry.allowRuntimeCreate`

## ⚠️ Trap for whoever takes this — the current behaviour is deliberately pinned

This is **not** a one-line change. Two existing suites pin the present computation on purpose, and one of them documents the distinction in its header:

- `PermissionMatrixEditor.readonlyHeaderBadge.test.tsx:17-19` — records that the **controls** read `!!resolved.allowOrgOverride && !readOnly` while the **badge** reads `entry.allowOrgOverride` alone, and that `permission` is one of the types where those diverge.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.readonly.test.tsx:153` — `allowOrgOverride=false hides Save and shows the environment badge`.

So before changing `:219`, establish whether those pins encode a **decision** (the type gate is intended to be stricter than the server) or merely **describe** the current code. If it is a decision, this card is a request to reverse it and needs a ruling rather than a patch. If it is description, the pins get updated alongside the fix — and the badge/controls divergence must be resolved deliberately, not left half-migrated.

## Suggested direction (from the source card)

Allow editing when the server would accept the package-door write — i.e. consult `allowRuntimeCreate` for the resolved package, in line with `DirectoryPage`/`EmbeddedItemEditor` — rather than gating solely on `allowOrgOverride`. Whatever lands should also make the **banner text** honest: `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE not enabled` is the wrong explanation when the actual cause is the per-type `allowOrgOverride:false`.

## Source

QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7637 (framework `92f26f75`, console `09987b680`), consolidated into objectstack-ai/objectstack#7685; split here by the `domain:cli` PM seat (objectstack#6024).
